name: Mattathias (Mattathias in Jesus' genealogy (Luke 3:25), son of Amos)
title: Ancestor in Jesus' lineage
summary: Mattathias is mentioned in Luke's genealogy of Jesus Christ as the son of Amos and father of Joseph. He is part of the long line of ancestors connecting Jesus to God's history of salvation. Beyond his place in the genealogy, no further biographical details about him are known in the Bible.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in Jesus' genealogy
keyEvents.description: Mattathias is listed as the son of Amos in Luke's genealogy, which traces Jesus' ancestry back through generations.

keyEvents.title: Part of God's plan of salvation
keyEvents.description: Through his place in the lineage, Mattathias is part of the divine plan that led to the coming of the Messiah.

keyEvents.title: The genealogy as confirmation of God's faithfulness
keyEvents.description: Luke's genealogy shows how God kept His promises through generations, and Mattathias is one link in this chain of faithfulness.

keyEvents.title: The Connection Between the Old and New Testaments
keyEvents.description: Mattathias likely belongs to the intertestamental period and represents God's enduring care for His people even during times without prophetic revelation.
